#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

const int MOD = 1e9+7;

struct mint {
    int v;
    mint() : v(0) {}
    mint(ll _v) : v(int(_v % MOD)) {
        if (v < 0) v += MOD;
    }
    explicit operator int() const { return v; }
    
    mint& operator+=(const mint& o) {
        if ((v += o.v) >= MOD) v -= MOD;
        return *this;
    }
    mint& operator-=(const mint& o) {
        if ((v -= o.v) < 0) v += MOD;
        return *this;
    }
    mint& operator*=(const mint& o) {
        v = (ll)v * o.v % MOD;
        return *this;
    }
    friend mint pow(mint a, ll p) {
        mint res = 1;
        for (; p; p /= 2, a *= a) if (p & 1) res *= a;
        return res;
    }
    friend mint inv(const mint& a) {
        assert(a.v != 0);
        return pow(a, MOD-2);
    }
    mint& operator/=(const mint& o) { return (*this) *= inv(o); }
    
    friend mint operator+(mint a, const mint& b) { return a += b; }
    friend mint operator-(mint a, const mint& b) { return a -= b; }
    friend mint operator*(mint a, const mint& b) { return a *= b; }
    friend mint operator/(mint a, const mint& b) { return a /= b; }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    int N, M;
    cin >> N >> M >> MOD;
    
    vector<vector<mint>> C(N+1, vector<mint>(N+1));
    for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
        C[i][0] = C[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j];
        }
    }
    
    vector<mint> ways(N+1), mad(N+1);
    ways[0] = 1;
    
    for (int n = 1; n <= N; n++) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            mint coef = C[n-1][i-1] * ways[i-1] * ways[n-i];
            ways[n] += (n+1) * coef;
            
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                mint dist = abs(j - i);
                mad[n] += dist * coef;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<vector<mint>> W(N+1, vector<mint>(M+1));
    vector<vector<mint>> D(N+1, vector<mint>(M+1));
    
    for (int n = 0; n <= N; n++) {
        W[n][0] = 1;
    }
    
    for (int n = 1; n <= N; n++) {
        for (int m = 1; m <= M; m++) {
            W[n][m] = W[n-1][m];
            D[n][m] = D[n-1][m];
            
            for (int len = 1; len <= min(n, m); len++) {
                mint coef = C[m][len] * ways[len];
                W[n][m] += W[n-len-1][m-len] * coef;
                
                D[n][m] += W[n-len-1][m-len] * D[len] + D[n-len-1][m-len] * coef;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << (int)D[N][M] << '\n';
    return 0;
}
